title: A bounded finite free model computing one degree of pseudo-coherent fibres
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] a pseudo-coherent complex [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], $i\in\mathbb Z$, and $x\in X$. There exist an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$, a commutative ring $A$, a homeomorphism $e:U\simeq\operatorname{Spec} A$, and a bounded complex $K$ of finite free $A$-modules, such that for every $z\in U$ the derived-fibre Betti number [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti] satisfies $\beta_i(E,z)=\dim_{\kappa(e(z))}H^i(K\otimes_A\kappa(e(z)))$. Only this fixed cohomological degree is asserted, not a bounded representative of $E$ itself.

proof.text: Choose the bounded-above finite free sheaf complex on a neighbourhood of x supplied by pseudo-coherence. Shrink to an affine open U containing x and restrict the comparison and free terms. Transport along the open-site equivalence and the affine chart to a finite-free sheaf complex on Spec A. Apply the existing proved affine_finiteFree_sheaf_complex_lift to get a bounded-above algebraic complex F and an isomorphism of its associated sheaf complex with this transported complex.

Set K to the stupid truncation of F in degrees at least i-1. The upper bound of F and the lower bound i-1 make K bounded, with finite free terms. Its terms and differentials in degrees i-1, i, i+1 are unchanged; consequently tensoring with any residue field preserves the same H^i. The bounded-above flat derived-pullback comparison computes the original derived fibres termwise. On the one-point residue spectrum, evaluation gives the corresponding algebraic cohomology vector space; transport along the affine residue-field isomorphism and take finrank. This proves the equality simultaneously for every z in U. If the upper bound is below i-1, K is zero, and the same argument gives zero H^i.

theorem exists_pseudoCoherent_fiber_finiteFree_model (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ x : X, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : IsPseudoCoherent X E) (i : ℤ) (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (A : Type u) (_ : CommRing A) (e : ↥(U : Set X) ≃ₜ PrimeSpectrum A)
        (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ),
        (∃ a b : ℤ, K.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ K.IsStrictlyLE b) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Free A (K.X n) ∧ Module.Finite A (K.X n)) ∧
        ∀ z : U, derivedFiberBetti X E i z =
          Module.finrank (e z).asIdeal.ResidueField
            ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars
              (algebraMap A (e z).asIdeal.ResidueField)).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K).homology i)
